stages.headline: A piecewise linear function has a graph made of segments and rays, e.g. y = |x| = x for x ≥ 0 and −x for x < 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: A piecewise linear function has a graph made of segments and rays, e.g. y = |x| = x for x ≥ 0 and −x for x < 0.

stages.headline: Functions with moduli are opened interval by interval: y = |x − 1| + |x + 1| is −2x (x < −1), 2 (−1 ≤ x ≤ 1), 2x (x > 1).
stages.headlineEnglish: Functions with moduli are opened interval by interval: y = |x − 1| + |x + 1| is −2x (x < −1), 2 (−1 ≤ x ≤ 1), 2x (x > 1).

stages.headline: A function may be given by several formulas: y = x + 2 for x < 0 and y = 2 − x for x ≥ 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: A function may be given by several formulas: y = x + 2 for x < 0 and y = 2 − x for x ≥ 0.
